latest.name: CATalyst v1.4.1
release_notes: This update installs an intentionally unsigned Windows beta. Microsoft SmartScreen may show the normal blue warning. Verify the SHA-256 sidecar before choosing More info and Run anyway.
The installer has no Authenticode publisher signature; only this update manifest is cryptographically signed.

The earlier v1.4.0 prerelease was withdrawn before website promotion because its signed notes lost the public issue-report link. This v1.4.1 prerelease corrects that release-metadata wording; the trading runtime is unchanged.

This is an opt-in Windows beta for testers. It is not a general public-readiness claim or an unattended-trading recommendation. Use a separate test wallet funded only with amounts you can afford to lose, and back up an existing CATalyst profile before upgrading.
